d.ko: Despite the popularity of, "La Soleil", Kashou's father continues to disapprove of it. Determined to get his father to approve of him, Kashou journeys to France to seek advice from the teacher who taught him his craft. A new chapter awaits in the next volume of the NEKOPARA series!

d.zh: 水无月嘉祥经营的蛋糕店"La Soleil"尽管大受好评，他的父亲却仍然不认可他的努力。嘉祥跟所有猫娘情人一起来到温泉度假，期间他决定去法国跟师傅求教。意想不到的是时雨也跟他同行！？然后他们在法国遇到了一只猫娘…。
